summary.text: James Burchett, a Republican from Waycross, was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2019 and represents District 176, which includes Atkinson and Lanier counties and portions of Coffee, Lowndes and Ware counties.

paragraphs.text: The House Republican Caucus elected Burchett House Majority Whip for the 2025-2026 term on November 12, 2024, his second term in that post.

sources.title: Rep. James Burchett Elected House Majority Whip
